references.text: Concerns special vows (נֵדֶר) to the Lord, here the Nazirite vow, illustrating the same principle of making distinct commitments to God
Addresses vows (נֶדֶר) made to the Lord and the obligation to fulfill them
Emphasizes the importance of keeping vows made to the Lord and that a vow must be fulfilled
Jephthah makes a special vow (נֵדֶר) to the Lord, an example of dedicating something to God through a vow
Hannah makes a vow to the Lord to dedicate her son to God, an example of dedicating a person (נֶפֶשׁ) to the Lord
Encouragement to make vows to the Lord and keep them
Exhortation to fulfill vows made to God without delay
Paul had made a vow, showing that vows to God were still practiced in New Testament times
Men who had taken a vow, and Paul participated in their purification ritual with them, connected to the practice of making vows
